## What's new
- **40 stocks** instead of 20: added Tesla, Netflix, AMD, Broadcom, Eli Lilly, Berkshire Hathaway, Oracle, Salesforce, Adobe, Disney, Bank of America, Intel, Pfizer, Nike, McDonald's, Boeing, AbbVie, Cisco, Qualcomm and Uber.
- **New Today page**: a morning market recap (30-second read or the full story), next week's forecasts at a glance, 9 market tiles with charts, overnight futures, and how every stock did.
- **More news**: CNBC, MarketWatch, The Wall Street Journal, Investing.com, Seeking Alpha and the Federal Reserve, plus a Whole market filter on the News page.
- **Open-source charts** (TradingView Lightweight Charts) and a live price strip.
- **Animations** throughout, a welcome box on your first visit, and a How to read page.
- The public page now updates twice each weekday, early morning and evening.

## Download
Under **Assets** below, click **Prolepsis-….zip** (not "Source code"), then unzip it.

- **Windows 10/11:** open the `Prolepsis` folder and double-click **`Start Stock Forecast.bat`**.
  If Windows shows "Windows protected your PC", click **More info**, then **Run anyway**.
- **Mac (M1 or newer, macOS 14+):** right-click **`Start Stock Forecast (Mac).command`** and choose **Open**.
- **Linux:** open a terminal in the folder and run `bash "Start Stock Forecast (Linux).sh"`.

The first start sets itself up (5-15 minutes, about 0.5 GB, nothing installed on your computer),
then builds the first forecast (about 15 minutes). Later starts are quick.

Don't want to download anything? Open the live page: https://faizsyed13.github.io/Prolepsis---Future-of-stock-forecasting/

Research project, not financial advice.
